title: Conventional unit identity
responsibility: Derives a unit kind and name from a workspace-relative conventional source path.

inputs.name: unitIdentity.path
inputs.description: Forward-slash path relative to its workspace, split on '/' only; its first segment selects the convention: src, scripts, db or crates. Paths whose last segment ends in .md, .json, .lock or .toml yield undefined, except crate files such as crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml.

inputs.name: unitIdentity.workspace
inputs.description: Optional prefix for the returned id: a non-empty workspace gives <workspace>.<kind>.<name>, while an empty or omitted one gives <kind>.<name>. It never changes kind or name.

outputs.name: unitIdentity
outputs.description: The unit identity with kind, kebab-case name and dotted id (prefixed by the workspace when one is given), or undefined when the path matches no convention, when a .md, .json, .lock or .toml file lies outside crates/, or when the name is empty. Every file under crates/<crate>/ gets kind kernel and its crate's kebab-case name, and inherited Object.prototype names such as constructor are matched by the table lookups, giving a non-string kind instead of undefined.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when the whole path is a single segment that the rootFolders lookup finds, such as scripts. The missing folder segment reaches stem as undefined, so its .replace call fails.
